ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-gray to 25% low-intensity black/dark-gray across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central dark-pigment blob at the peduncle junction extending vertically toward the notch; thick continuous dark-pigment banding along the entire trailing edge; scattered dark micro-mottling on the distal lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with sharp peaks and valleys across both lobes; highest amplitude of variation located on the inner-third of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a broader convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, textured pixel clusters with high relief localized at the far left and right distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified accretions and biological encrustation present on the outer margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'T-shaped' or hourglass black pigmentation pattern central to the fluke, bisecting the white ventral fields.
